# Rishang Bhavsar

> DevOps engineer in Ahmedabad, India, building secure, self-service AWS and Azure platforms with Terraform, Kubernetes and ArgoCD. 5+ years of DevOps experience (since April 2021). CKA, KCSA, Terraform Associate and RHCE certified. Open to platform and DevOps roles, remote or with relocation.

Currently a DevOps Engineer at SmartSense (GIFT City, Gandhinagar). Before that, Lab DevOps Engineer at KodeKloud, where he automated the hands-on cloud labs behind its DevOps courses. Focus areas: infrastructure as code, GitOps, cloud cost, identity and federation (OIDC, Keycloak), observability, and AI-assisted operations with MCP.

Key results:

- Cut AWS cost by more than 50% at SmartSense by migrating from multi-tenancy to a secure single-tenant architecture aligned with SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO.
- Took lab validation at KodeKloud from weeks of manual work to a few hours with an automated testing framework, plus AI-driven generation and fixes for lab content.
- Cut internal development infrastructure cost by 70% at OpenXcell while improving performance.

Contact: rishangbhavsar22@gmail.com

## Open source projects

- [terraform-aws-fargate](https://registry.terraform.io/modules/Rishang/fargate/aws/latest): Terraform module for ECS Fargate services (service, load balancer target groups and listener rules, service discovery, policy and scheduled autoscaling). About 230k downloads on the Terraform Registry. Source: https://github.com/Rishang/terraform-aws-fargate
- [install-release](https://github.com/Rishang/install-release): Python CLI that installs and updates single-binary tools from GitHub, GitLab and Codeberg releases on Linux, macOS and WSL. About 75k PyPI downloads.
- [helm-charts](https://github.com/Rishang/helm-charts): Two Helm charts on Artifact Hub. loki-stack is a one-install observability stack (Loki, Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Grafana Alloy). component-chart deploys any app component from a single values.yaml.
- [cu](https://github.com/Rishang/cu): Go CLI for everyday cloud work. Fuzzy-picks resources from AWS, Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault, Infisical and Kubernetes and prints JSON; also semantic config diffs and format conversion.
- [agno-spec-builder](https://github.com/Rishang/agno-spec-builder): Declarative YAML builder for Agno AI agents, teams, workflows, MCP servers and knowledge bases.
- [hterm](https://github.com/Rishang/hterm): Web terminal server in Rust with a built-in MCP server; read-only by default, with basic or proxy auth and TLS.
- [aws-oidc-broker](https://github.com/Rishang/aws-oidc-broker): OpenID credential broker for AWS IAM roles, an alternative to AWS SSO that supports OIDC federation. About 2k Docker pulls.
- [aws-tagger](https://github.com/ss-rishang/aws-tagger): Tags manually created AWS resources with owner and creation date, and sends Slack reminders to clean up stale resources.
- [aws-autoscale-warmup](https://github.com/Rishang/aws-autoscale-warmup): Scheduled AWS autoscaling ahead of known traffic peaks.

## Experience

- [SmartSense](https://smartsensesolutions.com/): DevOps Engineer, May 2025 to present. Terraform for AWS and Azure, GitOps with ArgoCD, single-tenant compliant AWS architecture, AI-assisted observability with Claude Code, AgentGateway and MCP servers for Grafana and Kubernetes.
- [KodeKloud](https://kodekloud.com/): Lab DevOps Engineer, March 2023 to April 2025. Cloud lab platform with role-based AWS access and cloud-nuke cleanup, automated lab testing, AI-driven lab content, LabUtils visibility platform.
- TechHolding: DevOps Engineer, September 2022 to February 2023. Infrastructure as code with Terraform and GitOps, security hardening.
- OpenXcell: DevOps Engineer, December 2021 to September 2022. Fintech, crypto and banking infrastructure; OIDC federation with Keycloak; EKS automation with Terraform; 70% internal infra cost cut; Employee of the Month.
- ElectroMech Corporation: DevOps Engineer, April 2021 to October 2021. Multi-account AWS with Terraform, IoT log streaming with Lambda, Timestream and QuickSight.
